title: Freya and the Salt
author: Wren Kavanagh
blurb: Coral Nakamura, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
